# Conf42 family media kit

> Logos (SVG/PNG/PDF/EPS in colour, black and white), colours (HEX/RGB/CMYK, design tokens), social banners, avatars and mascots for Conf42, SREday, LLMday, PLATFORMday, Prompt Engineering Conference, DevOps Not Dead, Reliaburger, CFP Ninja, Certified FYI and Badger.

- [Index (JSON)](https://www.conf42.com/assets/brandkit/brandkit.json): every file with url, size, px, sha256, mime
- [Index (Markdown)](https://www.conf42.com/assets/brandkit/brandkit.md)
